description:
Atomically reparent and/or retype a thought in one operation. Requires npub for credit billing.

Reparenting *replaces* the thought's existing parent link (the old parent child-link is
deleted and a new one created); it does not add an additional parent. To also set the
thought's name or label in the same call, use update_thought (which now accepts new_parent_id).

brain_id.description: The ID of the brain (uses active brain if not specified)

confirm.description:
If True, verify the reparent/retype against the authoritative
change-log (MOVED_LINK / SET_TYPE) instead of the cached graph, and
attach a ``confirmation`` block. Costs one extra billed read.

dpop_token.description: Proof that the caller holds npub. Either the grant envelope that receive_npub_proof returned, or the raw JSON of a kind-27235 Nostr event signed by npub: content "", a `u` tag holding this tool's exact name from tools/list, created_at within 60 s of now, and a random `nonce` tag.

new_parent_id.description: ID of the new parent thought (replaces all current parents)

new_type_id.description: ID of the new type to assign

npub.description: The patron's Nostr public key (npub1...). Tool fees are paid from this patron's balance; dpop_token proves the caller holds it.

thought_id.description: The ID of the thought to morph

name: brain_morph_thought
title: Move or retype a thought
